newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent futures continue to trade higher.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent futures continue to trade higher.

text.p: SIMEX Brent crude futures continued its uptrend to trade higher late Friday as the market remained bullish and active on news of a cold snap in the west.
The prompt January contract last traded at $23.31 per barrel, up 18 cents up from its last close on the International Petroleum Exchange (IPE), registering 223 lots at 0957 GMT.
February last traded at $22.75 per barrel, 22 cents above from Thursday's IPE close of $22.53.

A cold arctic high pressure was expected to push temperatures 16-24 degrees below normal in the northern U.S. over the next few days, staying below normal for another week, private forecaster Weather Services Corp reported.

The after-hours ACCESS trading system also continued to rise with January last traded at $24.10, up 26 cents from its last NYMEX close, while February last traded at $23.67, 19 cents over its previous close. -- Singapore Newsroom (+65-870-3084)
